posts.name: R. SANVITH MURARI
posts.cooked:
My specific doubt is on the topic: Are both OPPEs compulsory

My doubt is: Will i be eligible and get a final grade score if i appear in any one of the oppe and get >40 in the only one i appear? I understand that this would mean a reduction in total grade but will i still get a score is my question.

Recommended:
Mention what you have done till now to find clarification on the doubt:

posts.name: BHAVEN
posts.cooked:
According to the eligibility criteria mentioned in the grading document, if you score >= 40 in any one of the OPPEs then you are eligible to obtain a grade, but it will affect your overall score. If possible try to give both the OPPEs.

image812×100 10.5 KB

Source: Grading Document

posts.name: R. SANVITH MURARI
posts.cooked: but there is nothing like i have to repeat the course if i dont attempt any one oppe right?

posts.name: BHAVEN
posts.cooked: You have to score >=40 in any one of the OPPEs as mentioned in the grading document. You won’t have to repeat the course if you fulfill that criteria.
